# FLX-1003: integer outside the JSON safe-integer domain

**Family:** canonicalisation (the 1000 band)

RFC 8785 serialises JSON numbers through the IEEE 754 double domain, so an integer with magnitude above 2^53-1 has no canonical spelling. Carry a value this large as a decimal.Decimal (serialised as a string) or as its hex or base64 encoding.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-1003
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
